name: Mercenary Slice and Dice
notes: HoH1 Mercenary version of Slice and Dice (players/thief/mercenary/slice_and_dice_merc.sval, 18 skill points in the Mercenary skill shop). Against HoH1 level 4 (in brackets): same numbers; triggers on any class's primary attack. Mercenaries bought one fixed version of a class's skill once that class reached level 20 in town; its 'Primary Attack' wording let the class passives work with any weapon. Numbers are HoH1's, not this port's.
summary: Each primary attack hit, from any weapon, gives 2% attack speed, up to 32 stacks, lost after 2.5 s without attacking.
